text: Whoa!

text: Who left coffee on the floor?!

text: My roadmap! Oh. My back.
tagged: [groaning, pained] My roadmap! ... Oh. My back.

text: I saw someone duck in there.
tagged: [low, intrigued] I saw someone duck in there.

text: That hiding spot looks suspicious.

text: Nobody just vanishes. I will check there.
tagged: [thoughtful, deliberate] Nobody just vanishes. I will check there.

text: Where did they go?
tagged: [puzzled] Where did they go?
where: Sam lost you in a chase

text: Huh. Gone, like a startup in a down round.
tagged: [dry, amused] Huh. Gone, like a startup in a down round.

text: I haven't slept in three days for this RAM.
tagged: [tired, exasperated] I haven't slept in three days for this RAM.
where: Sam is frustrated after several misses

text: I'm not angry. I'm just aggressively optimistic.
tagged: [forced calm, strained smile] I'm not angry. I'm just aggressively optimistic.

text: Found you. Hello, Aj.
tagged: [delighted, smug] Found you. [chuckles] Hello, Aj.

text: Who turned off the lights?!
tagged: [irritated, shouting] Who turned off the lights?!

text: Power cut. Convenient. Very convenient.
tagged: [calm, then suspicious] Power cut. [pause] Convenient. Very convenient.

text: Wait... is that a cluster? In a hackerspace?
tagged: [curious, hushed] Wait... is that a cluster? [pause] In a hackerspace?

text: One chip online. Keep going!
tagged: [relieved, whispering] One chip online. Keep going!

text: One more chip. You are almost there!
tagged: [urgent whisper] One more chip. You are almost there!

text: Ha! He slipped! Go, go, go!
tagged: [laughing, whispering] Ha! He slipped! Go, go, go!

text: Lights out. Move while he can't see!
tagged: [excited whisper] Lights out. Move while he can't see!

text: Ouch. Shake it off, Aj.
tagged: [wincing, sympathetic] Ouch. Shake it off, Aj.

text: The cluster is live! You did it!
tagged: [overjoyed] The cluster is live! You did it!

text: That one is on Sam. Try again, Aj.
tagged: [gentle, encouraging] That one is on Sam. Try again, Aj.

text: Walk up to a locker, desk or crate and press E to hide a chip.
tagged: [calm, helpful] Walk up to a locker, desk or crate and press E to hide a chip.

text: Hold Shift to sprint, but it is loud. Press C to crouch and stay quiet.
tagged: [whispers] Hold Shift to sprint, but it is loud. Press C to crouch and stay quiet.

text: Watch the circle in the middle of the screen. When it fills up, Sam has spotted you.
tagged: [pointing it out] Watch the circle in the middle of the screen. When it fills up, Sam has spotted you.

text: The terminal in the north-west corner is the People's Cluster. Hold E there to upload chips.
tagged: [warm, quick] The terminal in the north-west corner is the People's Cluster. Hold E there to upload chips.

text: You can hide yourself too. Stand next to a locker or desk and press H. Just don't let him watch you do it.
tagged: [conspiratorial] You can hide yourself too. Stand next to a locker or desk and press H. Just don't let him watch you do it.

text: Press G to throw a decoy mug. The noise pulls Sam away.
tagged: [encouraging] Press G to throw a decoy mug. The noise pulls Sam away.

text: Press T to drop a coffee spill. Lure Sam over it.
tagged: [mischievous] Press T to drop a coffee spill. Lure Sam over it.

text: See the blue boxes on the walls? Press E at one and the whole room goes dark.
tagged: [excited whisper] See the blue boxes on the walls? Press E at one and the whole room goes dark.

text: Press F for your flashlight. But the light makes you easy to spot.
tagged: [anxious] Press F for your flashlight. But the light makes you easy to spot.

text: Sam has better ears tonight. Crouch with C, and think twice before you sprint.
tagged: [serious, quiet] Sam has better ears tonight. Crouch with C, and think twice before you sprint.

text: Last night. Keep going, Aj. You can do it.
tagged: [steady, proud] Last night. Keep going, Aj. You can do it.

text: I got you some decoy mugs. Press G to throw one. The noise pulls him away from your hiding spots.
tagged: [conspiratorial] I got you some decoy mugs. Press G to throw one. The noise pulls him away from your hiding spots.

text: I'm not angry about last night. I'm just very motivated.
tagged: [smooth, tight smile] I'm not angry about last night. I'm just very motivated.

text: Also the lights are flickering. Facilities says it is a feature.
tagged: [dry, tired] Also the lights are flickering. Facilities says it is a feature.

text: Press F for your flashlight. But be careful. A light in the dark is a very loud thing.
tagged: [anxious, whispering] Press F for your flashlight. But be careful. A light in the dark is a very loud thing.

text: Don't worry about the blackout, everyone. A true visionary can find RAM in the dark.
tagged: [confident, grand] Don't worry about the blackout, everyone. [smug] A true visionary can find RAM in the dark.

text: Sam has been practising. He can hear a chip click from across the room now, Aj.
tagged: [wary] Sam has been practising. He can hear a chip click from across the room now, Aj.

text: If he sees you duck into a hiding spot, he will check it first.
tagged: [urgent, low] If he sees you duck into a hiding spot, he will check it first.

text: I trained for this. Months of listening exercises. My roadmap depends on your RAM.
tagged: [proud, deadly serious] I trained for this. [pause] Months of listening exercises. My roadmap depends on your RAM.

text: Eight chips tonight. Use everything you have learned: decoys, traps, and the breakers.
tagged: [focused] Eight chips tonight. Use everything you have learned: decoys, traps, and the breakers.

text: Tonight we ship. Tonight the datacenter gets its RAM. Tonight nobody sleeps.
tagged: [intense, building] Tonight we ship. Tonight the datacenter gets its RAM. [pause] Tonight nobody sleeps.

text: Sunrise. Five nights. Not one stick. How is that even possible?
tagged: [baffled, hoarse] Sunrise. Five nights. Not one stick. [pause] How is that even possible?

text: You know, I did the math. A few more sticks would not have changed the roadmap.
tagged: [slowly, conceding] You know... I did the math. A few more sticks would not have changed the roadmap.

text: Fine. Keep your RAM. Maybe regular people can have a little, too. But not too much.
tagged: [sighs] Fine. Keep your RAM. [reluctant] Maybe regular people can have a little, too. [pause] But not too much.

text: Fine. I will just build more RAM. We have a very long runway.
tagged: [brightening, scheming] Fine. I will just build more RAM. We have a very long runway.

text: You did it, Aj! The RAM stays with the people. Thanks for playing RAM Heist.
tagged: [overjoyed, warm] You did it, Aj! The RAM stays with the people. [laughs] Thanks for playing RAM Heist.
